  "recovered_c": "uint64_t fn_18(const uint8_t *in, size_t len, uint64_t arg, uint8_t *out, size_t out_cap) {\n  size_t d = 0;\n  uint q = 0;\n  size_t i = 0;\n  uint8_t st[64];\n\n  while (i < len) {\n    uint8_t c = in[i];\n\n    if (q == 2) {\n      q = 1;\n    }\n    else if (q == 1) {\n      if (c == '\\') {\n        q = 2;\n      }\n      else if (c == '\"') {\n        q = 0;\n      }\n    }\n    else if (c == '\"') {\n      q = 1;\n    }\n    else if ((c == '(') || (c == '[') || (c == '{')) {\n      if (d == 64) {\n        return 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF;\n      }\n      if (c == '(') {\n        c = ')';\n      }\n      else {\n        c += 2;\n      }\n      st[d++] = c;\n    }\n    else if ((c == ')') || (c == ']') || (c == '}')) {\n      if (d == 0 || (c != st[d - 1])) {\n        return 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF;\n      }\n      d--;\n    }\n    i++;\n  }\n\n  if (d != 0) {\n    return 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF;\n  }\n\n  return 0;\n}"
